name: How can I tell if a wall is safe to frame or move without opening a can of worms?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a wall is safe to frame or move without opening a can of worms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important evidence is whether the wall is actually load-bearing, plus what is inside it. Stud direction, nearby beams, joists, and hidden wiring or plumbing all matter, and visual guessing is not enough for safe planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need to confirm whether the wall is load-bearing and whether utilities run through it. Visual clues help, but they are not reliable enough on their own.
